issue.title: _default_workspace() leaks temp directories on every call without explicit workspace_dir
issue.actual_behavior: _default_workspace() (line 270-271 of creator_production_readiness.py) returns Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='creator-system-production-readiness-')). This temp directory is never cleaned up — there is no shutil.rmtree(), no TemporaryDirectory context manager, and no finally block. Every call to build_creator_system_production_readiness() without an explicit workspace_dir leaks an entire temp directory tree into the OS temp directory, accumulating indefinitely.
issue.expected_behavior: When no explicit workspace_dir is provided, the auto-created temp directory should be cleaned up after build_creator_system_production_readiness() completes. Temp directories created internally for scratch work should not persist after the function returns.
repro_steps: Note it calls tempfile.mkdtemp() which creates a real OS temp directory.
Trace the call site in build_creator_system_production_readiness() at line 39 — when workspace_dir is None, _default_workspace() is called.
Search the entire function for shutil.rmtree, TemporaryDirectory, or finally — none exist.
Each invocation without workspace_dir leaks a directory tree under the OS temp path (e.g., /tmp/creator-system-production-readiness-XXXXXX/).
issue.affected_workflow: Any long-running or repeated caller of build_creator_system_production_readiness() without workspace_dir will accumulate temp directories, consuming disk space indefinitely

evidence.before_after_proof: Before (line 40-106): workspace = Path(workspace_dir) if workspace_dir else _default_workspace() followed by direct usage with no cleanup. After: added workspace_is_temp = workspace_dir is None flag, wrapped all workspace usage in try/finally block, added if workspace_is_temp and workspace.exists(): shutil.rmtree(workspace) in finally. User-provided workspace_dir paths are untouched.

proposed_fix.approach: Add import shutil. Wrap the workspace usage block in build_creator_system_production_readiness() with try/finally. Track workspace_is_temp = workspace_dir is None. In the finally block, call shutil.rmtree(workspace) only when the workspace was auto-created. User-provided workspace_dir paths are preserved as before.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: 12 of 15 existing tests pass. 3 pre-existing failures are unrelated (Windows path-length issue in mirofish content simulation, same failures on main). All tests that provide explicit workspace_dir are unaffected. The fix only changes cleanup behavior for the auto-created temp directory path.

review_claim.duplicate_notes: No existing PR addresses this temp directory leak in _default_workspace(). Other PRs fix different bugs in different modules.
review_claim.risk_notes: Low risk. The change adds a try/finally wrapper around existing code — no logic changes inside the try block. The shutil.rmtree() only runs when workspace was auto-created (workspace_dir is None). User-provided workspace directories are never touched. The return value is computed before cleanup runs, so the returned dict is identical.
